definitions.full: H4819. markoleth [ מַרְכֹּ֫לֶת ] noun feminine probably place of trade, market-place ; — suffix בְּמַרְכֻּלְתֵךְ Ezek 27:24 in thy market-place (Thes Buhl Lex Hi-Sm Krae and others; > ᵑ7 רְכֻלָּתֵךְ כָּם Co Berthol, compare Toy).
